controls.name: C_replay_proof_is_honest
controls.must_fire_because: the replayed proof must be BYTE-IDENTICAL to what an honest prover returns for q2 -- no forged digest, no edited key. If it is not, this is a tamper under a new name and S36 already covered tampers
controls.can_fail_because: any row where the replay differs from a fresh prove_completeness(root, q2)
controls.null_must_contain: a proof with any field rewritten, which is what all three of S36 tamper classes are

controls.name: C_replay_actually_omits
controls.must_fire_because: the replayed answer must be a STRICT subset of the true answer, or the probe never reached its target and "accepted" is a statement about nothing (A29)
controls.can_fail_because: any row with omitted == 0, or fewer than 10 jobs surviving the deeper-node filter
controls.null_must_contain: a deeper prefix selecting the same key set, which a path-compressed trie produces whenever the node does not branch

controls.name: C_fix_does_not_reject_honest
controls.must_fire_because: the q-bound verifier must still ACCEPT every honest proof. A verifier that returns False unconditionally rejects every cheat in this file and is worthless
controls.can_fail_because: any honest proof rejected under the fix
controls.null_must_contain: a verifier that rejects everything, which scores 100% on the attack and 0% here

controls.name: C_fix_keeps_the_three_published_tampers
controls.must_fire_because: omit / add / alter must still be rejected under the fix, so the q-binding is shown not to have replaced one check with another
controls.can_fail_because: any of the three tamper classes rejected < n under the fixed verifier
controls.null_must_contain: a verifier that checks only the query binding and not the fold, which would accept all three

controls.name: C_sibling_verifiers_are_not_exposed
controls.must_fire_because: the same replay shape against verify_membership and verify_non_membership -- the two that DO re-walk -- must be REJECTED. If they accepted, the defect would be in the commitment rather than in the missing check, and the fix would be aimed at the wrong layer
controls.can_fail_because: either sibling accepting a proof issued for a different key, or the two absent keys sharing a divergence node, where nothing is replayed
controls.null_must_contain: a verifier that folds to the root and stops, which is exactly what the COVER branch does

falsifiers.name: F_missing_rewalk_is_compensated
falsifiers.can_fail_because: the committed verifier ACCEPTS such a proof
falsifiers.null_must_contain: a genuine subtrie of the committed root, which folds correctly by construction
falsifiers.refutes: this attack: if a complete unforged proof for a deeper prefix is REJECTED when presented as the answer to a shallower query, S36 37/37 stands as a general claim about omission
falsifiers.fires_when: the committed verifier ACCEPTS such a proof

falsifier: the committed completeness verifier rejecting an unforged proof for a deeper prefix, which would leave S36 37/37 intact
